  seoc."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n",
  s."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n"

JOIN "crown_fire_probability" cfp ON c."hex_id" = cfp."hex_id"
JOIN "VUL_003" v ON c."hex_id" = v."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e1 ON c."hex_id" = e1."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e2 ON c."hex_id" = e2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON c."hex_id" = e3."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" l ON c."hex_id" = l."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" eoc ON c."hex_id" = eoc."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" seoc ON c."hex_id" = seoc."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" s ON c."hex_id" = s."hex_id"
WHERE c."County" LIKE '%Midland%'
ORDER BY cfp."crown_fire_prob" DESC;

cases.question: Major flooding in Harris County. Which infrastructure-dense areas face the greatest flood exposure? Identify substations and water treatment plants in high flood-risk zones.
Cat 3 hurricane approaching Nueces County. Identify viable evacuation corridors — roads not in high flood-risk zones. How many routes remain passable, and which populations need priority evacuation?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH NuecesHexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk WHERE UPPER(County) LIKE '%NUECES%'
),
PassableRoutes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.hex_id) AS passable_routes_count
    FROM "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" r
    JOIN HP_FLD_002 f ON r.hex_id = f.hex_id
    JOIN NuecesHexes n ON r.hex_id = n.hex_id
    WHERE f.nri_coastal_flood < 0.5 AND f.nri_riverine_flood < 0.5
),
PriorityPops AS (
    SELECT n.hex_id, v2.sovi, v4.psvi_score, p.population_7km
    FROM NuecesHexes n
    JOIN VUL_002 v2 ON n.hex_id = v2.hex_id
    JOIN VUL_004 v4 ON n.hex_id = v4.hex_id
    JOIN EX_POP_001 p ON n.hex_id = p.hex_id
    ORDER BY v2.sovi DESC, v4.psvi_score DESC, p.population_7km DESC
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT passable_routes_count FROM PassableRoutes), 0) AS passable_routes_count,
    pp.hex_id, 
    pp.sovi, 
    pp.psvi_score, 
    pp.population_7km
FROM PriorityPops pp
ORDER BY pp.sovi DESC, pp.psvi_score DESC, pp.population_7km DESC;
```

WITH NuecesHexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk WHERE UPPER(County) LIKE '%NUECES%'
),
PassableRoutes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.hex_id) AS passable_routes_count
    FROM "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" r
    JOIN HP_FLD_002 f ON r.hex_id = f.hex_id
    JOIN NuecesHexes n ON r.hex_id = n.hex_id
    WHERE f.nri_coastal_flood < 0.5 AND f.nri_riverine_flood < 0.5
),
PriorityPops AS (
    SELECT n.hex_id, v2.sovi, v4.psvi_score, p.population_7km
    FROM NuecesHexes n
    JOIN VUL_002 v2 ON n.hex_id = v2.hex_id
    JOIN VUL_004 v4 ON n.hex_id = v4.hex_id
    JOIN EX_POP_001 p ON n.hex_id = p.hex_id
    ORDER BY v2.sovi DESC, v4.psvi_score DESC, p.population_7km DESC
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT passable_routes_count FROM PassableRoutes), 0) AS passable_routes_count,
    pp.hex_id, 
    pp.sovi, 
    pp.psvi_score, 
    pp.population_7km
FROM PriorityPops pp
ORDER BY pp.sovi DESC, pp.psvi_score DESC, pp.population_7km DESC;

cases.question: Flooding in Bexar County. Estimate total buildings at risk, total flood EAL for high-risk hexes, and identify hospitals in the flood zone.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH bexar_hexes AS (
    SELECT "hex_id" FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" WHERE "County" = 'Bexar'
),
flood_hexes AS (
    SELECT h."hex_id"
    FROM "HP_FLD_002" h
    JOIN bexar_hexes b ON h."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
    WHERE h."nri_riverine_flood" > 0 OR h."nri_coastal_flood" > 0
),
buildings AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM("building_count"), 0) AS total_buildings_at_risk
    FROM "EX_BLD_001"
    WHERE "hex_id" IN (SELECT "hex_id" FROM flood_hexes)
),
eal AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM("nri_eal_RFLD" + "nri_eal_CFLD"), 0) AS total_flood_eal
    FROM "VUL_003"
    WHERE "hex_id" IN (SELECT "hex_id" FROM flood_hexes)
),
hospitals AS (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT("hex_id") AS hospitals_in_flood_zone
    FROM "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N"
    WHERE "hex_id" IN (SELECT "hex_id" FROM flood_hexes)
      AND "hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
)
SELECT b.total_buildings_at_risk, e.total_flood_eal, h.hospitals_in_flood_zone
FROM buildings b, eal e, hospitals h;
```

cases.question: Tornado striking Lubbock County. Assess the emergency resource gap — fire stations, law enforcement, and shelters relative to the at-risk population. Is mutual aid required?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(fire."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n") AS fire_stations,
  SUM(law."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n") AS law_enforcement,
  SUM(shelter."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n") AS shelters,
  SUM(pop."population_7km") AS at_risk_population,
  ROUND(SUM(fire."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pop."population_7km"), 0), 4) AS fire_stations_per_person,
  ROUND(SUM(law."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pop."population_7km"), 0), 4) AS law_enforcement_per_person,
  ROUND(SUM(shelter."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pop."population_7km"), 0), 4) AS shelters_per_person
FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk cw
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire ON cw."hex_id" = fire."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" law ON cw."hex_id" = law."hex_id"
```

cases.question: A Winter Storm Uri-like grid failure occurred in February. Now an early-season tropical storm is approaching in June of the same year. Model the compound sequential scenario.

```sql
  c."hex_id",
  c."nri_cri_value",
  h."hurr_strike_rate_10y",
  v."nri_eal",
  vi."inv_median_income",
  ROUND((100.0 - c."nri_cri_value") * h."hurr_strike_rate_10y" * v."nri_eal" / vi."inv_median_income", 4) AS compound_sequential_risk

JOIN "VUL_003" v ON c."hex_id" = v."hex_id"

  AND h."hurr_strike_rate_10y" IS NOT NULL

  AND vi."inv_median_income" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY compound_sequential_risk DESC;
```

cases.question: A comprehensive statewide compound-disaster event is in progress. Define the maximum-credible compound scenario and recommend top resilience investments across affected regions.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH RiskData AS (
    SELECT
        h.hex_id,
        COALESCE(h.nri_eal_RFLD, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_CFLD, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_HWAV, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_TRND, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_WFIR, 0) AS hazard_exposure,
        COALESCE(v.sovi, 0) AS social_vulnerability,
        COALESCE(c.nri_cri_value, 0) AS critical_risk,
        COALESCE(l1.groc_per1k, 0) + COALESCE(l2.pharm_per10k, 0) + COALESCE(l3.fuel_per10k, 0) + COALESCE(l4.hospital_per100k, 0) AS life_support_index,
        COALESCE(e1.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e2.hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e3.hifld_local_law_enforcement_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e4.hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e5.hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n, 0) AS emergency_capacity
    FROM "VUL_003" h
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "CR_001" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_001" l1 ON h.hex_id = l1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_002" l2 ON h.hex_id = l2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_003" l3 ON h.hex_id = l3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_004" l4 ON h.hex_id = l4.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" e1 ON h.hex_id = e1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" e2 ON h.hex_id = e2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" e3 ON h.hex_id = e3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" e4 ON h.hex_id = e4.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" e5 ON h.hex_id = e5.hex_id
),
CompoundRisk AS (
    SELECT
        hex_id,
        hazard_exposure,
        social_vulnerability,
        critical_risk,
        life_support_index,
        emergency_capacity,
        (hazard_exposure * 0.35) +
        (social_vulnerability * 0.25) +
        (critical_risk * 0.20) +
        (1.0 / (life_support_index + 0.001) * 5000) +
        (1.0 / (emergency_capacity + 0.001) * 5000) AS compound_risk_score
    FROM RiskData
),
Averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(hazard_exposure) AS avg_hazard,
        AVG(social_vulnerability) AS avg_vuln,
        AVG(critical_risk) AS avg_crit
    FROM CompoundRisk
)
SELECT
    cr.hex_id,
    ROUND(cr.compound_risk_score, 4) AS compound_risk_score,
    CASE
        WHEN cr.hazard_exposure > a.avg_hazard THEN 'Invest in flood, hurricane, and wildfire resilience infrastructure.'
        WHEN cr.social_vulnerability > a.avg_vuln THEN 'Allocate funds to social vulnerability mitigation and community support programs.'
        WHEN cr.critical_risk > a.avg_crit THEN 'Prioritize hardening of critical life-support facilities and supply chains.'
        ELSE 'Enhance emergency response capacity and public preparedness initiatives.'
    END AS recommended_investment
FROM CompoundRisk cr
CROSS JOIN Averages a
ORDER BY cr.compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

WITH RiskData AS (
    SELECT
        h.hex_id,
        COALESCE(h.nri_eal_RFLD, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_CFLD, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_HWAV, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_TRND, 0) + COALESCE(h.nri_eal_WFIR, 0) AS hazard_exposure,
        COALESCE(v.sovi, 0) AS social_vulnerability,
        COALESCE(c.nri_cri_value, 0) AS critical_risk,
        COALESCE(l1.groc_per1k, 0) + COALESCE(l2.pharm_per10k, 0) + COALESCE(l3.fuel_per10k, 0) + COALESCE(l4.hospital_per100k, 0) AS life_support_index,
        COALESCE(e1.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e2.hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e3.hifld_local_law_enforcement_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e4.hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n, 0) +
        COALESCE(e5.hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n, 0) AS emergency_capacity
    FROM "VUL_003" h
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "CR_001" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_001" l1 ON h.hex_id = l1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_002" l2 ON h.hex_id = l2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_003" l3 ON h.hex_id = l3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "EX_LIFE_004" l4 ON h.hex_id = l4.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" e1 ON h.hex_id = e1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" e2 ON h.hex_id = e2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" e3 ON h.hex_id = e3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" e4 ON h.hex_id = e4.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" e5 ON h.hex_id = e5.hex_id
),
CompoundRisk AS (
    SELECT
        hex_id,
        hazard_exposure,
        social_vulnerability,
        critical_risk,
        life_support_index,
        emergency_capacity,
        (hazard_exposure * 0.35) +
        (social_vulnerability * 0.25) +
        (critical_risk * 0.20) +
        (1.0 / (life_support_index + 0.001) * 5000) +
        (1.0 / (emergency_capacity + 0.001) * 5000) AS compound_risk_score
    FROM RiskData
),
Averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(hazard_exposure) AS avg_hazard,
        AVG(social_vulnerability) AS avg_vuln,
        AVG(critical_risk) AS avg_crit
    FROM CompoundRisk
)
SELECT
    cr.hex_id,
    ROUND(cr.compound_risk_score, 4) AS compound_risk_score,
    CASE
        WHEN cr.hazard_exposure > a.avg_hazard THEN 'Invest in flood, hurricane, and wildfire resilience infrastructure.'
        WHEN cr.social_vulnerability > a.avg_vuln THEN 'Allocate funds to social vulnerability mitigation and community support programs.'
        WHEN cr.critical_risk > a.avg_crit THEN 'Prioritize hardening of critical life-support facilities and supply chains.'
        ELSE 'Enhance emergency response capacity and public preparedness initiatives.'
    END AS recommended_investment
FROM CompoundRisk cr
CROSS JOIN Averages a
ORDER BY cr.compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
